name: Vulnerary
lore: Apply to the wound, not the mouth. Yes, we have to write that down now.

name: Elixir
lore: Price on request. The recipe died with the last temple apothecary.

name: Master Seal
lore: Commission, name line blank. Whoever signs it wakes up promoted, and sore.

name: Energy Drop
lore: One drop, one dose. Two drops, one fistfight you started. Keep from recruits.

name: Spirit Dust
lore: Ground from a chapel ward-stone. Taken on the tongue, the words come easier.

name: Secret Book
lore: Margin note in a second hand: page nine is wrong. Do it my way.

name: Speedwing
lore: A pegasus pinion that still twitches whenever the wind changes.

name: Dracoshield
lore: Genuine dragon scale! Sew it over the heart. No refunds issued to the dead.

name: Talisman
lore: Knot of red, knot of white, keep the hex-fire off tonight.

name: Angelic Robe
lore: Temple linen, blessed once and holding it still. Wear it under the mail.

name: Swiftsoles
lore: Courier guild insoles. Once fitted, they refuse to walk anywhere slowly.

name: Infantry Seal
lore: Form 9: reassigned to foot. Mount, saddle and dignity returned to stores.

name: Mounted Seal
lore: Requisition for one mount, hoof or wing. Feed it first; it will remember.

name: Herb
lore: Fen-leaf. Chew slowly. If it tastes worse than the poison, it's working.

name: Remedy
lore: Antidote, gauze, and a tin that doubles as a cup. Sells best on fen roads.
